research_question: Do later received tables establish one universal Beijing/Nanjing reference locality for all Yuan-Ming day-length and dawn/dusk constructions?

source_identification.edition_family: 欽定四庫全書本的公開維基文庫收本；不是已認證原刻／實物影像

direct_received_passages.section: 黃道每度晝夜刻立成（後接右厯草所載...）
direct_received_passages.context: Mei distinguishes a 黃道每度 daylight/night tally as the earlier Dadu/Yanjing scale; reports summer solstice daylight / winter solstice night max 六十一刻八十四分 and reciprocal min 三十八刻一十六分.
direct_received_passages.chronology_note: The same passage asserts an attempted Ming 正統己巳 change and a longer 南京軌漏 practice; this is Mei's later historiographical statement, not source-original 1449 clock evidence.

direct_received_passages.section: 大統歷依授時立成法下／冬至日後每日日出晨分半晝分
direct_received_passages.short_literal: 故知為陽城或南京晷刻也
direct_received_passages.context: Mei evaluates a separate 日出入／半晝夜／晨昏 table as below 60/40 solstitial ke, compares 河南府陽城 and 南京 polar-altitude descriptions, and leaves two place candidates instead of proving one origin.
direct_received_passages.place_specific_label_from_source: 北京日出入時刻晝夜長短 is a separately headed later table and cannot by name alone overwrite the preceding place ambiguity.

modern_companion_discovery.reported_claim: Its 授時大統可靠性驗證 paragraph differentiates 黃道積度 vs 積日 axes and 大都 vs 應天府 daylength settings across Yuan/SNU/Datong received tables.
modern_companion_discovery.critical_boundary: The modern compressed claim cannot substitute for Mei v5's explicit 陽城或南京 ambiguity; verify each source's actual first-party original table, axis and geographic standard before selecting a locality.

adjudication.positive: At least two differently labeled table/regime statements are present in the same later received Mei work; v3's Dadu daylight extrema and v5's candidate southern/central regime must not be silently normalized to one source.
adjudication.source_count_policy: Wikisource/CText/Wenlinshe textual presentations are NOT independent ancient physical votes; register one additional v3/v5 scope record, not three manuscripts.
adjudication.unresolved_next_original: Obtain an original dated printing/physical folio for these Mei v3/v5 lines and the period-local official DaTong TongGui and G893 table originals, then bind exact columns/day axes and physical site; 1447/1449/1450 source-clock anchors stay separately UNRESOLVED.

unproved_edges: Mei Qing received interpretation cannot be promoted into direct Ming-to-Qing clock continuation or G893 source lineage.
transmission_impact.scope: No graph edits; retain source-scoped alternative place hypotheses.
